title: Locksmith Estimate Template
subtitle: An estimate pre-filled for locksmith jobs — lockout, picking, rekeying, replacement, key duplication and labor. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Estimate valid for 30 days. A 25% deposit secures the booking; balance due at time of service.
notes: This is an estimate, not a final invoice. Emergency callout rates may differ from standard service after hours or on weekends.
features: Auto-calculating totals and 25% deposit in Excel
Pre-filled locksmith line items: lockout, picking, rekeying, replacement, keys, labor
License # field — many cities and states require a locksmith license on estimates and invoices
Valid-until date + deposit section standard for locksmith quotes

faqs.q: What should I include on a locksmith estimate?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name and license number, the client and job-site address, a dated line-item list (lockout, picking, rekeying, replacement, keys), a validity date, deposit terms, and a note that it is not a final invoice.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate the deposit automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantities and rates, and the subtotal, 25% deposit and balance due update automatically.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state and city — verify with your licensing authority and a CPA or attorney before use.
